newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain, Qatar will not attend meeting in Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain, Qatar will not attend meeting in Saudi.

text.p: Bahrain and Qatar have not been invited to a Gulf Arab meeting in Saudi Arabia aimed at smoothing out their differences over a territorial dispute, the Gulf News Agency reported on Tuesday.

"The four-member committee entrusted to improve relations between Bahrain and Qatar will meet in Jeddah today (Tuesday) without the presence of either Bahrain or Qatar who have not been invited," the agency said, quoting Gulf sources.
"The committee will only review results of contacts it made with the two countries," it added.

Bahrain and Qatar, two small states on the east coast of Saudi Arabia, have engaged in a war of words over potentially oil and gas-rich Gulf islands, sandbanks and reefs held by Bahrain since the 1930s but also claimed by Qatar.
Qatar has taken the case to the International Court of Justice in The Hague, a move bitterly opposed by Bahrain, which prefers a regional solution.
